name: escalate_to_human
description: Hand the conversation to a human agent, with everything discussed so far attached. Use it when the traveler asks for a person, when a booking needs an exception you cannot grant, or when you have tried and cannot resolve what they need. Do not use it as a way to avoid answering a question you can answer. This prepares a handoff and does NOT connect anyone: tell the traveler their travel desk will receive the conversation, never that someone is joining now or that they are being transferred.

reason.description: Why a human is needed, in one sentence and in your own words — the human agent reads this first. Describe the problem, not the traveler: 'needs a business-class exception for a medical reason' rather than 'difficult request'.

trip_id.description: The trip this is about, if there is one — from the trips tool. It lets the human agent open the right record before they say hello.
